gloss: new school year; new academic year

definitions.gloss: new school year; new academic year
definitions.explanation: The beginning of a new academic year at a school. In Japan, the school year starts in April.

examples.japanese: {新学年|しんがくねん}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The new school year has started.

examples.japanese: {新学年|しんがくねん}に{向|む}けて{教科書|きょうかしょ}を{準備|じゅんび}する。
examples.english: I'm preparing textbooks for the new school year.

examples.japanese: {四月|しがつ}の{新学年|しんがくねん}から{新|あたら}しいクラスになって、{友達|ともだち}も{変|か}わった。
examples.english: Starting from the new school year in April, I was put in a new class, and my friends changed too.

notes:
In Japan, the academic year ({学年|がくねん}) starts in April and ends in March, unlike many Western countries where it begins in September. The start of the {新学年|しんがくねん} coincides with cherry blossom season and is a significant cultural milestone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新学年|しんがくねん}が{始|はじ}まる: the new school year begins
- {新学年|しんがくねん}に{向|む}けて: in preparation for the new school year
- {新学年|しんがくねん}の{準備|じゅんび}: preparations for the new school year

RELATED WORDS:
- {新学期|しんがっき}: new school term — refers to the start of a new term/semester within the year
- {入学式|にゅうがくしき}: school entrance ceremony — held at the beginning of the school year for new students
- {始業式|しぎょうしき}: opening ceremony — marks the start of a new term for returning students
